scope: Candidate coverage for LAFAN40 / G1 29DoF. This is a dated, non-exhaustive inventory; unconfirmed means not verified in the inspected sources, not proof that no release exists.
selection: Prioritize independent controller families and representative institutions. Count checkpoint versions separately from model families.

entries.name: OmniXtreme
entries.gap: Three author ONNX components and native inference comparison passed; full-suite evaluation and repeat remain incomplete.
entries.next_step: Finish both complete runs, trace verification and source checks.

entries.name: Humanoid-GPT
entries.gap: The 216 checkpoint run encountered a MuJoCo numerical reset. The author-recommended 264 checkpoint requires a separate inference comparison.
entries.next_step: Audit the 264 deployment contract, then rerun the complete suite. A numerical reset is not a valid complete trajectory.

entries.name: YAHMP
entries.gap: The inspected training and viewer implementations differ in history timing and angular-velocity frame. Viewer parity alone does not resolve this discrepancy.
entries.next_step: Establish the intended released-checkpoint inference contract before ranking.

entries.name: HoloMotion v1.3.1
entries.gap: The released ONNX cache fails at step 8192 in the inspected runtime; its paired author deployment does not supply a verified reset path.
entries.next_step: Verify an author-supported cache/reset procedure. Other HoloMotion versions have separate ranked records.

entries.name: ULTRA tracking teacher
entries.gap: The released tracking teacher has object-conditioned inputs. The absent-object convention for this motion-only track is not yet verified.
entries.next_step: Check the original object-input and reference conventions; distinguish the tracking teacher from the multimodal student.

entries.name: FRoM-W1 H-ACT
entries.gap: The inspected released G1 Full and Clean policy configurations use 21 actions.
entries.next_step: Evaluate in a compatible robot track or verify an official 29-action release.

entries.name: GMT
entries.gap: The inspected author deployment uses 23 actions.
entries.next_step: Evaluate in a compatible robot track or verify an official 29-action release.

entries.name: KungfuBot2 / PBHC
entries.gap: Inspected checkpoints target individual motions; a generalist configuration does not establish a released generalist weight.
entries.next_step: Locate an author-released general-reference tracking checkpoint.

entries.name: UniTracker
entries.gap: A downloadable official tracking checkpoint has not been verified in the inspected author sources.
entries.next_step: Confirm a public author artifact and its deployment contract.

entries.name: PGMT
entries.gap: The inspected project page describes the controller; a public policy artifact has not been verified.
entries.next_step: Confirm a public author artifact and supported terrain/robot inputs.

entries.name: MimicKit
entries.gap: The framework and model archive need inspection to distinguish G1 general-reference trackers from single-motion policies.
entries.next_step: Identify a compatible released checkpoint before creating a model entry.

entries.name: ScaleBFM
entries.gap: The existing converted artifact came from a shared deployment archive; its original-to-export equivalence chain is incomplete.
entries.next_step: Reproduce conversion from the author checkpoint and compare inference.
